scientific_integrity: Finite tests are consistency checks. The universal theorem invokes Kudo’s proved maximality of the untwisted curve and a complete tame character computation. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified nonzero diagonal coefficient family over \(\mathbf F_{p^2}\), with p prime congruent to 11 or 14 modulo 15; the fifteen parameters need not be distinct curve-isomorphism classes. Unindexed explicit twist tables or published specializations of general Jacobi-sum results may affect priority.
title: Four Weil spectra and a fifth-extension dichotomy among superspecial trigonal genus-five twists
